environment: **Purpose**: A ROS2 CLI that samples selected topic fields into time-aligned rows — live pinned-header view on a tty, CSV when piped or redirected.
**Package manager**: system python3 (ROS2 Jazzy); no uv and no pyproject.toml. The ROS package builds with colcon.

**Run**: metawtf <conf-file>. The console script is a colcon byproduct: colcon build --packages-select metawtf && source install/setup.bash. Sample config in metawtf/metawtf.conf; grammar in its header.
**Test**: python3 -m pytest -q from the repo root (232 tests; needs no sourced workspace). Known issue: colcon test collects 0 tests — see chores.
